summary: A survey of 2,778 AI researchers predicts a 50% chance of AI outperforming humans in all tasks by 2047, 13 years earlier than previously estimated, and a 10% chance by 2027. Respondents express significant concern about extreme risks, including human extinction, and broadly agree that risk mitigation research should be prioritized.

claims.text: 2,778 researchers who had published in top-tier AI venues participated in the survey.
claims.evidence_quote: 2,778 researchers who had published in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) venues gave predictions

claims.text: There is at least a 50% chance that AI systems will autonomously construct a payment processing site from scratch by 2028.
claims.evidence_quote: at least a 50% chance of AI systems achieving several milestones by 2028, including autonomously constructing a payment processing site from scratch

claims.text: There is at least a 50% chance that AI systems will create a song indistinguishable from a new song by a popular musician by 2028.
claims.evidence_quote: creating a song indistinguishable from a new song by a popular musician

claims.text: There is at least a 50% chance that AI systems will autonomously download and fine-tune a large language model by 2028.
claims.evidence_quote: autonomously downloading and fine-tuning a large language model

claims.text: The chance of unaided machines outperforming humans in every possible task was estimated at 10% by 2027.
claims.evidence_quote: the chance of unaided machines outperforming humans in every possible task was estimated at 10% by 2027

claims.text: The chance of unaided machines outperforming humans in every possible task was estimated at 50% by 2047.
The 2047 estimate is 13 years earlier than the estimate from a similar survey conducted one year earlier.
claims.evidence_quote: The latter estimate is 13 years earlier than that reached in a similar survey we conducted only one year earlier

claims.text: The chance of all human occupations becoming fully automatable was forecast to reach 10% by 2037.
claims.evidence_quote: the chance of all human occupations becoming fully automatable was forecast to reach 10% by 2037

claims.text: The chance of all human occupations becoming fully automatable was forecast to reach 50% as late as 2116.
68.3% of respondents thought good outcomes from superhuman AI are more likely than bad.
claims.evidence_quote: 68.3% thought good outcomes from superhuman AI are more likely than bad

claims.text: 48% of net optimists gave at least a 5% chance of extremely bad outcomes such as human extinction.
claims.evidence_quote: 48% gave at least a 5% chance of extremely bad outcomes such as human extinction

claims.text: 59% of net pessimists gave 5% or more to extremely good outcomes.
claims.evidence_quote: 59% of net pessimists gave 5% or more to extremely good outcomes

claims.text: Between 38% and 51% of respondents gave at least a 10% chance to advanced AI leading to outcomes as bad as human extinction.
claims.evidence_quote: Between 38% and 51% of respondents gave at least a 10% chance to advanced AI leading to outcomes as bad as human extinction

claims.text: More than half of respondents suggested that 'substantial' or 'extreme' concern is warranted about six different AI-related scenarios, including misinformation, authoritarian control, and inequality.
claims.evidence_quote: More than half suggested that "substantial" or "extreme" concern is warranted about six different AI-related scenarios, including misinformation, authoritarian control, and inequality

claims.text: There was broad agreement that research aimed at minimizing potential risks from AI systems ought to be prioritized more.
claims.evidence_quote: there was broad agreement that research aimed at minimizing potential risks from AI systems ought to be prioritized more
